_about: Non-whisky lines of the 33 I3 photos that the whisky labels (eval/labels_i3_v1.json) do not have. Read by ai/eval/p46_report.py (I4-P46). Same fields as ai/regression/mixed_lines.json.

Made on 2026-11-17 before prompt v2 was run on these photos: labelers A and B (both Claude) listed the non-whisky lines of every photo from the photos only, without the labels, the gold, OCR or any model output. They found the same 20 rows on the same 5 photos and no other photo with a non-whisky line. The two differences were judged against the photo: the tequila on the 연림 promotion page is printed '후세쿠엘보 실버' (A), and the Korean name comes first as in the whisky labels of that page (A).

6 of the 20 rows are already in the labels with match gold non_whisky (a rum on 테일오브테일즈_04, cognac on 쏘댓page2_04 and 무용의 유용_02); they count as non-whisky lines of category other and are not repeated here. The 14 rows below are the rest.
Not rows: the footnote '하이볼 제작비 1,000' (연림 서울대입구역점_02-04) and the tab titles of other pages (무용의 유용_01-02), as labels_i3_v1.json excluded_sections records.
category: cocktail, food or other (other spirits, wine, beer). unit: glass, bottle or null. The two beers have one price and no unit printed; glass by the price rule of the prompt.
